home.hero_title: Equipping Saints • Raising Kingdom Leaders • Transforming Nations
home.hero_sub: Living Waters Global School of Ministry equips ministers, marketplace leaders and kingdom entrepreneurs with academic excellence rooted in biblical purpose — taught in English and French.
home.vision_body: To raise a generation of Spirit-filled, biblically grounded, and transformational leaders who carry God's presence, advance His Kingdom, and impact nations through Christ-centred ministry and service.
home.mission_body: Living Waters Global School of Ministry exists to equip, train, and disciple believers through sound biblical teaching, practical ministry training, leadership development, and spiritual formation — empowering them to fulfil their divine calling and become effective ambassadors of Christ in every sphere of influence. "To equip the saints for the work of ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ." — Ephesians 4:12 (NKJV)
home.programs_sub: Purposefully designed learning pathways — from certificates to advanced diplomas — rooted in kingdom values and practical leadership excellence.
home.program_cert_desc: 6-month focused courses in Kingdom Business, Ministry HR, and Digital Outreach — ideal for those beginning their leadership journey.
home.program_dip_desc: 12-month comprehensive programmes in Ministry Leadership, Finance & Stewardship, Project Management and Church Planting.
home.program_adv_desc: A 6 months intensive hybrid programme equipping ministers with biblical knowledge, spiritual formation, and practical experience for pastoral ordination and licensing.
home.events_sub: Stay connected with LWGSM admissions updates, ministry events and programme news.
home.events_empty: No announcements at this time. Check back soon.
home.testimonials_title: Transformed by the Word and by Excellence
home.testimonials_sub: Real stories from kingdom leaders who have been equipped through LWGSM.
home.nations_sub: LWGSM trains ministry and marketplace leaders across the nations, worldwide.
home.why_sub: A learning experience built to advance God's purposes through excellent education.
home.why_1_desc: Every course is designed around biblical principles — equipping you to lead with faith, integrity and purpose in church and marketplace.
home.why_2_desc: Study at your own pace with bilingual materials, live sessions and recorded lectures — designed for busy ministers and marketplace leaders.
home.why_3_desc: Every certificate is digitally verifiable, giving churches, organisations and employers confidence in your qualification.
home.why_4_desc: Learn from lecturers who combine academic excellence with real ministry experience — practitioners, not just professors.
